name: workflow_run_step
description: Execute a workflow step by spawning a step sub-session that loads the step's skill and runs it to completion. By default, runs the step at the current cursor; pass stepId to run a specific step. Returns the step's output along with a refreshed run state (cursor, ctx, completed). This is the ONLY tool that performs substantive work — the orchestrator must never attempt to perform a step's work itself. After inspecting the result, the orchestrator should call workflow_complete_step to commit, or workflow_goto to jump elsewhere if the result is unsatisfactory.

runId.description: The run identifier returned by workflow_create.

stepId.description: Optional. Run a specific step instead of the current cursor. Must resolve to an existing id in the workflow tree.

inputOverride.description: Optional. Override the step's resolved input for this invocation only. Used sparingly — prefer letting the workflow resolve $ctx.* and $input.* references.
